steps.text: You shouldn't follow me.
Where I am going, the flames of war rage unchecked.
You'd only be in the way. No need to get yourself killed.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Savra, what are you doing, standing there? Get down if you want to live!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: *Sarkaz profanity*! Incoming! Take cover and keep your head down!
*Cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You still alive?!
I'm fine.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: They found our vantage point. We don't have much time left! Get a move on!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Again, so soon?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Argghhh! Son of a...! My leg!
(Uses Arts)
This way!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: *Cough*. Thanks, brother.
All I did was find us some cover. No need to thank me.
Is your leg doing okay?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I'm fine. I've been scratched up like this many times before. I'll be okay with a bandage.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I'm probably not one to talk, but you don't seem like you can hold your own in a fight that well. I'm surprised you managed to survive this long.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I saw you use Arts to move the cover. That's the technique of a seasoned veteran.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: How long have you been on the battlefield?
I've been through training many times, but I'm afraid this is my first deployment.
I only made it this far thanks to luck. I haven't done anything too great.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Well, you're a humble one, I'll give you that.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Anyway, we really can't keep this up for much longer.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: The bigwigs are probably having an easy time, but this is starting to be a bit too much to bear for the rest of us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Looks like we're the only ones left here. I wonder how the others are doing.
I got separated from my team... Our ambush failed, and the enemy scattered us.
It doesn't look like much is happening up ahead. I'm guessing anyone who charged up ahead are all...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Well, what a coincidence. It's the same for me.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I'm not expecting them to go back to help me at this point.
The mission may be a failure, but I'm not planning on dying here.
I'll scout out our surroundings. We may be trapped, but there has to be a way to break out of this.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Scout? You?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Listen, I'm not trying to look down on you, brother.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: But I promise, it doesn't matter how much cover your Arts can make you. The moment you poke your head out, you'll be blown to pieces.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: My suggestion: We stay here and observe.
I'm afraid we can't do that.
3 o'clock... We've got company.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Those freaking Kuranta?
They're light infantry. Most likely the Kuranta mercenaries. There may be others as well... They work together fairly often, after all.
Once they charge in here, we won't have anywhere to run.
They might even have some caster drones with them.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: How'd you know that much?
Simple deduction, guesswork, and experience.
I could be wrong, of course, but that should more or less be it.
We may stand out if we go now, but we can't hide here for very long.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: If you know so much about them, do you have a way to take them out too?
I'm afraid not with my Arts. I'll probably be killed the moment I try to attack.
Honestly, running away is about all I can manage right now.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hahahaha, sounds like whoever hired you really got a lemon.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: They're losing this war because they're too stingy and only bought men like you. You get what you pay for.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: By the way, before I forget...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What's your name, Savra?

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: I have many names. You can call me 46A for now.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Heh, is that a name now? Sounds more like a model number for some kind of appliance.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: It's just one of my codenames. You can call me that for the time being.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Well, it sounds to me you haven't made up your mind.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: My name isn't important.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Guess it isn't. Looks like you're the same as me. Just playing it by ear, earning our keep.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Was that an explosion?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Quick, 46A! Let's go!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I've been a merc for a long time, but this is my first time seeing anyone use drones to guide artillery fire.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Those drone casters are getting way too hard to deal with these days.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: If we'd found out sooner, so many of us would still be alive...

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: I tried to cover our tracks. Hopefully that will buy us some time.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You know all kinds of Arts, don't you?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Why don't you take care of these wounds for me while you are at it?

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: Sorry, I don't know healing Arts.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: It's fine. Just figured I'd ask.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: Our medic was the second one to go missing.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Don't let it get to you, brother. It happens pretty often out here.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: If it wasn't for you, the Kuranta would've blown a hole through my guts already.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: So nobody else made it out?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Looks like it.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: But that also means we're safe.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Can you walk on your own?

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Let's keep going, then. The rendezvous point shouldn't be much further. If we keep this up, we should be there in about an hour.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I really backed the wrong horse this time. The nobles were paying top dollar, so I figured this one was a sure win.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Who knew we'd get all those mortar shells dropped on us? The moment that happened, everyone just took off, running for dear life.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I feel sorry for those brothers I've fought alongside over the years.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: They got their money, but at what cost?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: How about you, 46A? You here because of how much they were willing to pay, too?

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: There were some supplies I needed.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hah, no need to sugarcoat it like that. All of us are putting our lives on the line to earn our crust.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: I'm looking for someone as well.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Looking for someone? What, on the battlefield?

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: That's correct.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Who are you looking for? Family? An enemy?

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: Someone I owe my life.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hoh.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: That's interesting.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Well, it sounds like something you'd do, but you're probably looking in the wrong place.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: It's a life debt, and—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Fine, whatever. Let me give you a bit of advice. Don't let yourself be taken advantage of!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I wasn't going to say this, but you're a weird one. Do you really think you can find the one who saved your life in Kazdel?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Maybe they weren't even trying to save you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Think about all those men you've worked for up till now, all the people you've worked with. All of them ready to turn against you at a moment's notice.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Maybe the moment you find them, they'll—
I never imagined I would make such a mistake. I didn't see the attack coming at all.
Were those explosives? Arts?
My ears are buzzing.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...
But I'm not going to die here.
Even if I can't see anything, even if I have to crawl my way out of here, I am going to live.
You always make it through everything alive, Savra.
But I never thought you'd make it this far.
You are not like those good-for-nothings.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: Who are you...?
You've made it this far. You have my approval.
I guess I must also give you a conclusion.
Will you face your past?
Or will you face the future?
Make your decision.
The Savra feebly holds his staff up.

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: Can I come with you this time, Owl?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Rise and shine, young'un.

steps.name: 12F
steps.text: Ughh......

steps.name: 12F
steps.text: What are you doing here, Mr. Rangers...?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Everyone else is busy today, so it's just us two Savra sharing drinks and conversation.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Do you remember now?

steps.name: 12F
steps.text: R-Right... It's coming back to me.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Here, have some cold water.

steps.name: 12F
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Try rubbing your eyes. Harder.

steps.name: 12F
steps.text: *Phew*... *huff*.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: This is how I used to sober myself up when I was your age. It does the trick, doesn't it?

steps.name: 12F
steps.text: I suppose. Thank you, Mr. Rangers.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: No need to thank me. We're both Savra.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: This is a kind of remedy I came up with. Only works on us folk.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Were you dreaming, 12F? You seemed rather stiff.

steps.name: 12F
steps.text: Oh, I guess I did have a rather strange dream.

steps.name: 12F
steps.text: Something from the past came back to me, that's all.
Tell me. What's your name?

steps.name: 46A
steps.text: I... I don't have a name... Only a codename.
Well, you just follow me from here on out. Like I said, there'll be far more dangers waiting ahead of you.
How far you can make it. Well, that depends on you.
Who you've been up till now just died here. Today is the day you died. It's also the day you were born.
Right, why don't I give you a new name as a present?
Let's see. It's March 3rd today...
Alright, you'll be 12F from here on out.
